articles.title: Houthis Step Up Pressure on Front Lines by Shelling Residential Areas
articles.description: The humanitarian consequences of the Houthi escalation in Yemen have intensified as the group steps up attacks on residential areas in rural Lahj Governorate and around the city of Taiz, according to government sources. Growing numbers of families are fleeing the fighting, while relief organizations struggle to meet mounting needs in a country already facing one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
